decisions.reason: Although related to airport services, a passenger-facing mobile app is furthest from the firm's core security and operational know-how, so with weak visible follow-up and limited sectoral R&D depth the firm is less likely to keep investing in learning and improvement here.

Passenger processing technology sits very close to the firm's established airport-security expertise, and as a launched product line it gives a large firm with in-house technology development good scope to learn from deployments and refine it commercially.

A self-service airline check-in solution fits the firm's existing airport operations and efficiency-focused offer, so absorptive capacity is reasonably strong, though demand uncertainty and modest external knowledge links make it less secure than the core technology line.
